note_text: Bilateral digital mammography with tomosynthesis. Left breast: 3.4 cm spiculated high-density mass at the lower inner quadrant. Axilla: enlarged dense lymph node in the axillary tail. Transthoracic echocardiography (baseline before anthracycline): LVEF 65%. No regional wall motion abnormality.
